'''Zarrak's medallion''' was a powerful object that granted the user the ability to stun individuals and [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] move rocks. [[Zarrak]], an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] user of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark magics]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]] was the only known user of this device, and he used it to attack his enemies. During a showdown with [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] from [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], Zarrak used his medallion to capture the Ewoks, [[Logray/Legends|Logray]], [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], and [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] in prisons of stone. However, when the Ewok [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] attacked Zarrak, he dropped the medallion which crumbled into pieces.
